segments.ja503:2.3: Tassā [tasmā (syā. pī. ka.)] kuṭiyā nikkhamma, suvo luddāni bhāsati.
segments.ja503:4.3: Handassābharaṇaṃ sabbaṃ, gaṇhāma sāhasā [sahasā (sī. syā. pī.)] mayaṃ.
segments.ja503:5.1: Nisīthepi raho dāni, sutto rājā sasārathi;
segments.ja503:5.3: Ādāya vatthaṃ maṇikuṇḍalañca, hantvāna sākhāhi avattharāma.
segments.ja503:6.3: Durāsadā hi rājāno, aggi pajjalito yathā.
segments.ja503:7.1: Atha tvaṃ patikolamba, matto thullāni gajjasi;
segments.ja503:7.3: Mātari mayhaṃ naggāya, kinnu tvaṃ vijigucchase.
segments.ja503:8.1: Uṭṭhehi samma taramāno, rathaṃ yojehi sārathi;
segments.ja503:8.3: Sakuṇo me na ruccati, aññaṃ gacchāma assamaṃ.
segments.ja503:9.1: Yutto ratho mahārāja, yutto ca balavāhano;
segments.ja503:10.1: Ko numeva gatā [kva nu’ me’ pagatā (?)] sabbe, ye asmiṃ paricārakā;
segments.ja503:10.3: Esa gacchati pañcālo, mutto tesaṃ adassanā.
segments.ja503:11.3: Esa gacchati pañcālo, mā vo muñcittha jīvataṃ [jīvitaṃ (bahūsu)].
segments.ja503:12.3: Svāgataṃ te mahārāja, atho te adurāgataṃ;
segments.ja503:13.3: Phalāni khuddakappāni, bhuñja rāja varaṃ varaṃ.
segments.ja503:14.3: Tato piva mahārāja, sace tvaṃ abhikaṅkhasi.
segments.ja503:15.1: Araññaṃ uñchāya gatā, ye asmiṃ paricārakā;
segments.ja503:15.3: Sayaṃ uṭṭhāya gaṇhavho, hatthā me natthi dātave.
segments.ja503:16.3: Atheso itaro pakkhī, suvo luddāni bhāsati.
segments.ja503:17.1: “Etaṃ hanatha bandhatha, mā vo muñcittha jīvataṃ”;
segments.ja503:19.1: Sattigumbo ca corānaṃ, ahañca isīnaṃ idha;
segments.ja503:19.3: Asataṃ so, sataṃ ahaṃ, tena dhammena no vinā.
segments.ja503:20.1: Tattha vadho ca bandho ca, nikatī vañcanāni ca;
segments.ja503:20.3: Ālopā sāhasākārā, tāni so tattha sikkhati.
segments.ja503:21.1: Idha saccañca dhammo ca, ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo;
segments.ja503:21.3: Āsanūdakadāyīnaṃ, aṅke vaddhosmi bhāradha [bhārata (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja503:22.1: Yaṃ yañhi rāja bhajati, santaṃ vā yadi vā asaṃ;
segments.ja503:22.3: Sīlavantaṃ visīlaṃ vā, vasaṃ tasseva gacchati.
segments.ja503:23.3: Sopi tādisako hoti, sahavāso hi [sahavāsopi (syā. ka.)] tādiso.
segments.ja503:24.5: Upalepabhayā [upalimpabhayā (syā. ka.)] dhīro, neva pāpasakhā siyā.
segments.ja503:25.3: Kusāpi pūti [pūtī (sī. pī.)] vāyanti, evaṃ bālūpasevanā.
segments.ja503:26.3: Pattāpi surabhi [surabhī (sī. syā. pī.)] vāyanti, evaṃ dhīrūpasevanā.
segments.ja503:27.1: Tasmā pattapuṭasseva [phalapuṭasseva (sī. pī.), palapuṭasseva (ka. aṭṭha.), palāsapuṭasseva (syā. ka.)], ñatvā sampākamattano;
segments.ja503:27.5: Asanto nirayaṃ nenti, santo pāpenti suggatinti.
